title: Integrated single-cell and spatial transcriptomic analyses identify an SFRP2 + fibroblast state associated with gastric cancer perineural invasion.
snippet: Perineural invasion (PNI) marks aggressive gastric cancer, yet the stromal states associated with nerve-invasive disease remain poorly resolved.
